description: This file defines a Pinia store named 'product' for managing a list of products within a Vue.js application. It includes state management for products and actions to add, update, and delete products.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a new product to the store with a generated ID, timestamp, and default status.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Updates an existing product identified by ID with provided updates.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Removes a product from the store based on its ID.
